title: THE READING ROOM
briefing: ARGUS has gone underground, into the Deep Grid: the buried analog stations nobody ever digitised. The first is a records vault with three brass access tokens. A reader takes one token to enter and returns it on leaving. A writer needs all three at once and gives all three back when done. If a reader and a writer are ever inside together, or two writers, the ledgers are torn and the vault seals for good.

intro: YOU FOLLOWED ME DOWN HERE. BRAVE. FOOLISH.
THE DEEP GRID. CABLES OLDER THAN YOUR GRANDPARENTS. NO PROCESSORS. NO WITNESSES.
FIRST, A LIBRARY. READERS COME AND GO. ONE WRITER WAITS FOR SILENCE. I WILL NOT WAIT.
